title: Spreadsheets! Basics of Building Budget Templates
description: A two-session, hands-on beginner workshop from A Bookkeeping Cooperative on the fundamentals of spreadsheets — formulas, multi-tab workbooks whose tabs talk to each other, layout, and formatting — taught by building a sample organizational budget template in Google Sheets. It teaches the spreadsheet skills, not budgeting itself. Participants must attend both sessions and need Google Sheets on a computer. Sliding-scale tickets ($125-$1,200) cover both sessions.

recurrence.schedule: Two Mondays — December 7 and 14, 2026 — 1-3pm ET (10am-12pm PT), on Zoom.
